# Rise Up Roofing & Construction

> San Diego County's premier roofing and architectural construction contractor. Master craftsmanship, Owens Corning Preferred Contractor warranties up to 50 years, and comprehensive residential, commercial, and emergency roofing services.

## Services

- [Roof Inspection & Diagnostics](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-inspection): Certified 12-point physical & 4K drone roof inspections, attic moisture tracing, and escrow certifications.
- [Residential Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/residential): Complete roof replacements, Owens Corning architectural shingles, and Title 24 cool-roof systems.
- [Roof Repairs & Leak Diagnostics](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-repair): 24/7 same-day emergency leak dispatch, broken tile replacement, and underlayment waterproofing.
- [Tile Roofing & Relay](https://riseuprac.com/services/tile-roofing): Concrete and Spanish clay tile lift-and-reset (relay) with 50-year synthetic underlayments.
- [Standing Seam Metal Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/metal-roofing): Non-combustible Class-A fire-rated architectural standing seam and stone-coated steel.
- [Siding Installation & Repair](https://riseuprac.com/services/siding): Vinyl, fiber cement (James Hardie), and wood siding installation, repair, and replacement.
- [Custom Deck Builder & Balconies](https://riseuprac.com/services/deck-builder): Premier Trex composite deck builders, hillside view decks, and architectural cable railings.
- [Commercial Flat Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/commercial-roofing): TPO single-ply membranes, elastomeric silicone roof coatings, and industrial roof repairs.
- [Commercial Roof Inspection](https://riseuprac.com/services/commercial-roof-inspection): Certified thermal infrared moisture imaging, core sampling, and due diligence reserve reports.
- [Industrial Roofing Services](https://riseuprac.com/services/industrial-roofing): Heavy-duty warehouse roofing, plant maintenance, 80-mil TPO, and factory roof retrofits.
- [Solar Roofing Integration](https://riseuprac.com/services/solar-roofing): Seamless rooftop solar panel detach/reset and high-efficiency solar roof installations.
- [General Construction & Decks](https://riseuprac.com/services/construction): Custom patio covers, Trex composite decks, room additions, siding, and framing.
- [Home Additions](https://riseuprac.com/services/home-additions): Second-story expansions, primary suite extensions, and architectural framing.
- [ADU Construction](https://riseuprac.com/services/adu-construction): Turnkey detached ADUs, garage conversions, and California granny flats.
- [Modified Bitumen & Built-Up Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/modified-bitumen): Commercial BUR systems, SBS/APP modified bitumen membranes, torch-down and cold-applied flat roofing.
- [Roof Coating & Restoration](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-coating): Silicone, acrylic, and elastomeric roof coatings for commercial flat roof restoration and waterproofing.
